- **Shape.** Draft on `main`; `Fixes #25897`; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; changeset `.changeset/25897-record-read-mode-wraps-text.md` in the root `.changeset/` (patch, plugin-detail).
- **Checks pinned to the head.** 61 named check runs, latest per name: 54 success, 7 skipped, 0 failing, 0 pending. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, Test UI 16/16, Type Check UI all success.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 25998`: 0 of 7 paths governed.
- **Changeset against the diff.** Read mode routes a value whose renderer IS `TextCellRenderer` (by identity, so a host's own cell for that type is kept) through `TextField`'s readonly display, coercing the value as the cell did. Grid cells are untouched (control test). The highlights strip gives `date` / `datetime` chips the 16rem floor, from measured faces. Each sentence matches the code.
- **Deviations accepted.** The `date` chip rides along as a bounded same-class fix. The objectui#11577 control ("text keeps TextCellRenderer") is reversed, because that is the behaviour the card changes. `DateTimeCellRenderer` stays untouched (the "let the chip grow" arm). `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` is a derived hash, on the claim amendment.

⚠️ Landing waits for its turn. Every ui PR moves the same manifest-record line, so the queue takes one at a time: #25978, #25984, #25987, then this PR. When the seat pings, the card thread merges `origin/main` and regenerates the record. The seat then re-checks the head and arms auto-merge.
